answer: Bind each agent to one IPv4 /24 prefix with a valid RPKI Route Origin Authorization from its Regional Internet Registry. The operator proves prefix control and a matching ROA; validation rejects any prefix without one. A /24 lease runs $50–$130 monthly plus a $250 yearly fee, so one fake identity costs near $1,800 a year and a 10,000-agent farm needs 10,000 prefixes — about $18 million a year. Address space does not grow in a garden: every knoll of IPv4 is already claimed, a hijacked prefix fails validation, and no unclaimed block waits on the horizon.
